The need of these types of areas cannot be overlooked. If demand and interest indicates the need for an ORV area, the site should be provided where feasible. Prior to designation of such an area, thorough examination of all related factors and conflicts must be completed. With this type of planning, land use provisions of off-road recreational vehicles can be established to the satisfaction of the majority of public land users.
